one_line: Ethiopian-born military strategist and regent of Ahmadnagar who led mobile Deccan resistance to the Mughals and reformed land revenue.

appearance.age_look: Late 40s to mid 50s, lean but wiry build, about 5'8" with the presence of a seasoned cavalry commander.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, deep brown complexion, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, slightly sharp nose, tired but sharp eyes with faint under-eye lines; default expression is calm, calculating focus with a hint of restrained defiance.
appearance.hair: Tightly curled black hair kept short and close to the scalp, mostly hidden under a deep indigo Deccani turban wrapped low and snug, with a narrow white cloth band near the base and a small, simple gold turban-ornament disc on the left side.
appearance.costume: He wears a long, knee-length quilted cotton jama in muted off-white with fine vertical stitching and side-tied overlap closing right over left, over a light steel-grey mail shirt suggested at the collar; a broad, dark maroon cloth sash is wrapped firmly around his waist, knotted on his left hip with the ends hanging to mid-thigh; beneath, he has narrow white churidar-style trousers with soft, gathered folds at the ankles, and plain brown leather riding boots that rise just below the calf with simple stitched seams; over his shoulders is a dark indigo woollen cavalry cloak, split at the front and back for riding, its inside lining a softer dull ochre, worn open so it flares slightly when he moves; he wears minimal jewellery—small plain gold hoop earrings and a modest signet-style ring on his right hand—emphasising practical, Deccan-appropriate martial attire around 1600–1620.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Deccani talwar with a simple steel hilt and disc pommel, sheathed in a dark brown leather scabbard edged with brass, hanging from a dark maroon cloth baldric crossing his chest from right shoulder to left hip; he often rests his left hand on the hilt, symbolising constant readiness.

ref_desc: Malik Ambar is a deep-brown-skinned, oval-faced, short-bearded man in an off-white quilted jama over steel-grey mail, dark maroon waist-sash and baldric, deep indigo turban and riding cloak, white churidar trousers, brown leather boots, and a brass-edged talwar at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Malik Ambar as a dignified Deccan regent and cavalry strategist: a deep-brown-skinned, oval-faced man in his late 40s–50s with high cheekbones, tired yet sharp eyes, and a neatly trimmed short black beard and moustache, his tightly curled black hair cropped short under a deep indigo Deccani turban wrapped low with a narrow white band and a small round gold ornament on the left. Show him wearing a knee-length, off-white quilted cotton jama with visible fine vertical stitching, overlapping right over left, over a subtly visible steel-grey mail shirt at the collar; a broad dark maroon cloth sash is tightly wrapped around his waist and knotted on his left hip with the ends hanging down, and a matching dark maroon cloth baldric crosses from right shoulder to left hip. Underneath, depict slim white churidar-style trousers gathered at the ankles, and sturdy brown leather riding boots reaching just below the calf with simple stitched seams. Over his shoulders, add a dark indigo woollen cavalry cloak with a dull ochre lining, open at the front and split for riding so it can flare slightly; give him small plain gold hoop earrings and a modest ring on his right hand but otherwise minimal ornamentation. His signature weapon, a slightly curved Deccani talwar with a plain steel hilt and disc pommel in a dark brown leather scabbard edged in brass, hangs at his left hip from the baldric, with his left hand often resting lightly on the hilt. Use a palette dominated by deep indigo, off-white, dark maroon, steel grey and brown leather, and present him from multiple angles to clearly show face, turban, cloak, jama, trousers, boots and talwar consistently.
